permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Departures, connections and place search from Transitous (MOTIS), walking directions from FOSSGIS OpenStreetMap routing, and map streets from the public Overpass API or from your own Overpass server if you enter one in the phone app.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Find the stops near you, plan routes from where you are, guide you on foot and by vehicle, and follow the next stop while riding.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Record the destination you say, only after you tap "Say a destination" on the glasses and until you tap again (at most 15 s). The recording is sent to a speech-to-text server you set up and is not stored.
